h: Funke Akindele and MC Oluomo's moment at an event goes viral as fans react
p: A video of Nollywood star Funke Akindele and Lagos event figure MC Oluomo sharing a moment at an event is trending, with fans reacting in large numbers online.
more: The clip has been widely shared on social media.
Fans have reacted in large numbers.
